messages:
DeployBot: Scheduled migration `mig_922_fanout` will start in 60 minutes on prod (regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1). Backfill mode: rolling 5% waves. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mig_922 :calendar: 
Jia Li: Thanks. Confirming backfill waves are tenant groups not rows?
Samir Patel: tenant groups. Also can we set a hard row limit per wave? we saw read spikes last time.
Priya Nair: +1 to row limit. Suggest `MAX_ROWS_PER_WAVE=200k` and `SLEEP_MS=10000` between waves.
Noah Chen: Lock behavior question: will this upgrade add any indexes or do FK validation? need to avoid long tx.
DeployBot: Migration plan: add column `external_id` default NULL, then async backfill, then `NOT NULL` validate in a later deploy. No FK validation in this run.
Marta Gomez (oncall): If p99 DB latency > 300ms for 5m window -> pause. Who will hit the pause?
Priya Nair: ops oncall (Marta) can hit `/deploybot pause mig_922` and open the rollback hatch if needed. Also we should pin the service version before final validate.
Jia Li: Leaving a note: will pin api-service@v2.14.3 for the next two hours after backfill completes. avoids unexpected validation code.
Samir Patel: Thx. Also adding a preflight command for the first wave: ```sh
psql -c "select count(*) from users where external_id IS NULL limit 1;"
# sanity: ensure replica lag < 30s
```
Noah Chen: If deploybot fails during wave 3, what's rollback? do we have partial backfill safepoint?
DeployBot: Automatic checkpoint created after each wave as `mig_922_checkpoint_<wave_num>`. Rollback procedure: restore to last checkpoint + mark unfinished tenants for manual remap. Runbook link above.
Marta Gomez (oncall): I'll be watching metrics and will post a pause or abort signal here if needed. Please keep replies short so I can triage quickly. :eyes: 
Priya Nair: Quick checklist before go: (1) pin api-service, (2) set MAX_ROWS_PER_WAVE=200k, (3) confirm replica lag <30s, (4) oncall ready.
Jia Li: All done except 3 — running replica lag check now, will post result < 10m.
Samir Patel: I'll temp increase DB connection pool by 10% on workers to smooth backfill bursts.
Noah Chen: leaving a small snippet for the postbackfill validate: ```sql
-- postbackfill check
select count(*) from users where external_id is null and created_at < now() - interval '7 days';
```
DeployBot: 30m warning: migration starts in 30 minutes.
Jia Li: replica lag: 12s (us-west-2 primary->readreplica). good to go.
Marta Gomez (oncall): I'm at my desk. If I post `:pause:` that means pause, `:abort:` means rollback.
Priya Nair: Roger. Tagging release notes: add note about staged column add + async backfill, and pinned api-service v2.14.3 for the validate window.
Samir Patel: putting a small safety flag in config: `FEATURE_MIG_922_SAFE_MODE=true` so validators read that.
Noah Chen: LGTM. monitoring dash ready.
DeployBot: Migration started. wave=1, tenants=120, rows_target=200k, checkpoint=mig_922_checkpoint_1.
Jia Li: wave1 looks clean. latency + p99 unchanged.
Samir Patel: wave2 starting. increasing worker pool applied.
Marta Gomez (oncall): all quiet. no pause. 
Priya Nair: wave3 starting in ~5m. reminder: no FK step yet.
DeployBot: wave=3 failed to complete on tenant 87 due to transient timeout, checkpoint created for wave 2. Automatic retry scheduled in 2m.
Noah Chen: retry ok. keep an eye on tail latencies.
Jia Li: retry succeeded. checkpoint mig_922_checkpoint_3 created.
DeployBot: migration complete. final checkpoint mig_922_checkpoint_final. async validate scheduled in 24h.
Marta Gomez (oncall): marking thread resolved from monitoring perspective. thanks everyone. :tada:
